stem:
A Massachusetts pharmacy is preparing an adult influenza clinic under a valid standing order. A qualified immunizing pharmacist will counsel patients, select each vaccine and directly supervise administration. Two fully licensed technicians have current CPR certification and completed the ACPE six-hour technician course, including two hours of live injection training.

Alex is not nationally certified, has worked 520 hours after full technician licensure, and has completed 90 minutes of documented on-the-job training with an experienced certified immunizer. Blake holds current PTCB certification, has worked 300 hours after full technician licensure, and has completed two additional documented on-the-job hours with an experienced certified immunizer. Both have completed a skills checklist. All other applicable conditions are satisfied.

Which staffing assignment is permitted now? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Assign Alex to prepare and administer vaccines; Blake must first reach 500 post-licensure hours.
Assign Blake to prepare and administer vaccines; Alex needs further on-the-job training.
Assign both technicians because the six-hour course includes the required workplace training.
Assign neither technician until each holds national certification and has 500 post-licensure hours.

explanation.core_reasoning: 국가 certification 또는 면허 후 500시간의 대안과 6시간 기본 과정·최소 2시간 추가 OJT·checklist·CPR를 분리한다. Blake는 certification 경로로 500시간 미만이어도 적격이다. Alex는 500시간 경로를 갖췄어도 90분 OJT 때문에 아직 투여할 수 없다. Technician은 약사의 임상 선택을 대신하지 않는다.

choice_analysis.A: Alex의 520시간은 national certification 대신 사용할 수 있는 경험 자격을 충족한다. 그러나 추가 OJT 90분은 최소 2시간에 미달한다. 반대로 Blake는 national certification이 있으므로 500시간을 별도로 채울 필요가 없다. 자격 대안과 별도 교육 요건을 뒤바꾼 배정이다.
choice_analysis.B: Blake는 national certification이라는 자격 대안을 충족하고 6시간 과정 및 추가 OJT 2시간·checklist·CPR를 갖췄다. Alex는 경험 대안은 충족했으나 추가 OJT가 30분 부족하다. Pharmacist의 환자 상담·백신 선택 후 승인 및 직접 감독 아래 physical preparation/administration을 배정하는 범위다.
choice_analysis.C: 6시간 ACPE 과정의 live training과 최소 2시간의 추가 documented OJT는 별개다. 과정 안의 2시간 live training을 다시 workplace OJT로 계산하여 Alex의 90분을 보완할 수 없다. Checklist를 끝냈다는 사실도 요구된 추가 시간을 줄이지 않는다.
choice_analysis.D: 정책 III(D)(1)은 national certification 또는 full PT licensure 이후 500시간을 대안으로 정한다. 두 조건을 모두 요구하지 않는다. Blake가 300시간이라는 이유로 현재 적격성을 부정할 수 없고, Alex에게 필요한 것은 certification 취득이 아니라 부족한 추가 OJT의 보완이다.

explanation.learning_boundary: 성인 routine-vaccine clinic에서 technician 자격과 추가 OJT를 적용한다. 소아 연령 경계, travel vaccines, off-site clinic, MIIS 및 adverse-event reporting의 전체 요건은 이 사례의 범위 밖이다.

design_change_ko: 미완료 OJT라는 정답 명칭을 stem에서 반복하지 않는다. 실제 90분/2시간, certification/면허 후 근무시간을 제공하여 지금 배정 가능한 사람을 법규로 판단하게 한다.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: A patient asks a Massachusetts community pharmacist to administer methadone for addiction treatment. The patient presents a valid prescription from a practitioner, and the pharmacist has completed injection training and holds current CPR certification. May the pharmacist administer it there?

choices.text: Yes, because the pharmacist holds a valid prescription for the patient.
Yes, because the pharmacist has completed the required training and certification.
No, because that administration may occur only in a registered opioid treatment program.
No, because a pharmacist may never administer any medication for addiction treatment.
No, unless the prescriber attends the pharmacy at the time of administration.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
A fully licensed technician has worked 520 hours after full licensure, has current CPR, and has completed the required six-hour vaccine course. National certification is not held. The documented on-the-job skills training has not yet occurred.

Which remaining requirement is identified by these facts? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Repeating 500 hours as a trainee before using the completed full-license hours.
Obtaining national certification because experience cannot be used instead.
Completing a PharmD before any supervised vaccine administration.
The additional documented on-the-job training and skills checklist.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
Case A: A technician completes a six-hour ACPE-accredited vaccination course that includes two live hours but skips the separate documented on-the-job training.

Case B: A second technician's course is entirely recorded video, and the pharmacy proposes substituting unsupervised practice for hands-on assessment.

Which proposed interpretation is INCORRECT? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Technician training may omit vaccine-reaction recognition if the pharmacist is present.
The six-hour course does not replace the additional two hours of documented on-the-job training.
The course must include the specified live instruction and hands-on technique assessment.
On-the-job training requires an experienced certified immunizer and documented skills assessment.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
A technician's vaccine-training file contains a six-hour ACPE course completed entirely through recorded modules. The technician also completed two documented hours of on-the-job training with an experienced certified immunizer and a skills checklist. The MOR is reviewing the initial education requirements for the DPH vaccine program.

What education deficiency remains? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: None; the six course hours and two on-the-job hours may be combined into an undifferentiated eight-hour total.
The on-the-job hours must be doubled, after which the recorded course can count as the required live component.
The ACPE course must satisfy the live-training requirement; the additional on-the-job training does not replace it.
One hour of annual immunization CE can replace the missing course component because that is the pharmacist standard.

nearby_comparison.finding_ko: Original0020의 missingOJT echo와 달리90분 대2시간, certification 대500h를 실제 배정에 적용한다. EXP0316/RW0047은 별도 live/OJT 요구를 다루지만 recordedcourse 결함이 핵심이고, 현재는 두 직원 중 누가 지금 투여할 수 있는지를 결정한다. Canonical0329의 methadoneOTP 제한과는 권한/행위가 다르다.
